summary: Onboarding and Non-Profit Application Backend Testing COMPLETED. All 23 API tests passed (100%). Fixed critical bug in EmailService import. All endpoints are properly protected with authentication and admin middleware.
action_items: IMPORTANT: Run CREATE_ONBOARDING_TABLES.sql in Supabase to create required tables (onboarding_responses, nonprofit_applications) before testing with authenticated users
critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIXED: onboardingRoutes.js line 5 - Changed 'import * as EmailService' to 'import { EmailService }' to correctly access sendNonprofitApprovalEmail and sendNonprofitRejectionEmail functions
✅ onboardingRoutes.js: All 11 endpoints properly implemented with verifyToken middleware
✅ Admin endpoints (lines 346-591): Correctly use requireAdmin middleware to verify is_admin=true in profiles table
✅ POST /api/onboarding/save (lines 32-98): Properly upserts onboarding_responses and updates profiles.onboarding_completed
✅ POST /api/onboarding/nonprofit/apply (lines 127-223): Creates nonprofit_applications record, updates profile with nonprofit_status='pending'
✅ POST /api/onboarding/nonprofit/resubmit (lines 254-338): Validates only rejected applications can be resubmitted, creates new application record
✅ POST /api/onboarding/admin/nonprofit/approve (lines 443-530): Generates unique discount code (NP + 8 chars), creates promo_codes record, sends approval email with magic link
✅ POST /api/onboarding/admin/nonprofit/reject (lines 536-591): Updates status to rejected, sends rejection email with reason
✅ GET /api/onboarding/nonprofit/verify-magic-link (lines 597-639): Public endpoint to verify magic link token and discount code
✅ uploadRoutes.js: Document upload to Supabase storage with proper file type validation (PDF, PNG, JPG only), 10MB limit
✅ serverEmail.js: sendNonprofitApprovalEmail and sendNonprofitRejectionEmail properly implemented with HTML templates
